IDT12420.synoptic: A high pressure system centred in The Bight, extends a ridge of high pressure over Tasmania. The high and ridge will move slowly eastwards during the week to be over Tasmania on Wednesday and in the Tasman Sea on Thursday. A low pressure system and associated trough approach from the west on Thursday and is forecast to move over the state on Friday. Another weak ridge is expected to develop over Tasmania on Saturday.

IDT12326.text:
Tuesday 17 November
Winds: Southwesterly 20 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots during the afternoon and evening.
Seas: 2 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 2.5 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Cloudy.

Wednesday 18 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 20 knots becoming variable about 10 knots in the morning.
Seas: 1 to 2 metres, decreasing below 1 metre during the morning.

Weather: Cloudy.

Thursday 19 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming southeast to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots in the early morning then tending east to southeasterly in the middle of the day.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 2.5 to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 20 November
Winds: East to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots tending north to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots during the day.
Seas: Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres near Tasman Island.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Weather: Cloudy. 80% chance of showers.
